candidates.change_summary: Return bytes4(0) instead of the function's own selector, so a completed call returns a different value.
Return a fixed different selector constant instead of ERC721TokenReceiver.onERC721Received.selector, changing the returned bytes4 value.
Remove the return statement so the function returns the default value 0 instead of its selector.
Delete the statement `baseToken = _baseToken;` so baseToken remains address(0) after initialize.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = _nft;` so baseToken is set to the NFT address instead.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = nft;` so baseToken is assigned the (stale/zero) current nft value instead of the parameter.
Replace `baseToken = _baseToken;` with `baseToken = address(0);` so baseToken is always zero after initialize.
